summary: Lattice AI today is a genuinely working local-first FastAPI + SQLite knowledge-graph workspace (ingestion pipeline, hybrid search, provenance, portability, model routing, /app SPA) whose marketing layer was rebranded to "Digital Brain Platform" in v3.6.0 — but the identity is only skin-deep: packaging, principles docs, the UI information architecture, and half the docs still say "AI workspace", and a literal second brain (the P-Reinforce "knowledge garden" markdown vault at ~/.ltcai-brain) bypasses the Knowledge Graph that README claims "every source converges into". Naming is badly fragmented (Lattice AI / ltcai / LTCAI / .ltcai / .ltcai-brain / LATTICEAI_* and LATTICE_* env prefixes / garden / Workspace OS / Local Agent), and the README overclaims agent/workflow capability that FEATURE_STATUS.md itself admits is deterministic and LLM-free. The exceptional asset is FEATURE_STATUS.md: an unusually honest, file:line-cited ledger that makes the gap between claim and implementation auditable.
strengths: The v4 thesis is already articulated verbatim in shipped docs: README.md:6,28-38 and ARCHITECTURE.md:3-7 state 'models are replaceable, knowledge is durable; the Knowledge Graph is the durable asset' — the identity destination exists, it just isn't enforced everywhere.

FEATURE_STATUS.md is a rare honesty ledger: a WORKING/PARTIAL/PLACEHOLDER/DISABLED/BROKEN legend (FEATURE_STATUS.md:74-82), file:line citations for every claim, self-documented past overclaims (v3.4.0 hardcoded Local Agent constants, FEATURE_STATUS.md:57,444-456), explicit admission the multi-agent runner is LLM-free (lines 318-319), and an honest 'Vercel returns HTTP 500 on every route, not production-ready' note (lines 500-507). Keep and institutionalize this.

docs/EDITION_STRATEGY.md is a clean, principled open-core contract: 'Community is never crippled', the enterprise seam only ever reports enabled=False, and admin UIs honestly say 'not available in this build' (FEATURE_STATUS.md:475-485).

v3.6.0 substance is real, not just rebranding: unified ingestion (latticeai/services/ingestion.py), provenance table, export/import/backup (latticeai/services/kg_portability.py), and a 127.0.0.1-only browser extension — all backed by the 455-passing unit suite and consistent with local-first/privacy-first.
Documented cross-cutting honesty mechanisms in the frontend: api.js never fabricates data, chat shows 'no model loaded' banners instead of fake replies (FEATURE_STATUS.md:489-498).

PROJECT_PRINCIPLES.md and AI_PHILOSOPHY.md carry a coherent user-agency ethic ('the user should not work for AI', 'do not hide capability in the name of protection') that fits a digital-sovereignty product.

problems.title: A second, parallel 'brain' bypasses the Knowledge Graph, falsifying the core identity claim
problems.detail: README.md:8-10 and ARCHITECTURE.md:14-15 claim 'every source converges into one Knowledge Graph — no source bypasses it, none becomes a silo'. But p_reinforce.py (PReinforceGardener) maintains a completely separate Obsidian-style markdown vault at ~/.ltcai-brain (BRAIN_DIR, literally branded '# 🧠 Lattice AI Brain — P-Reinforce Index'), with its own rule-based classifier and folder taxonomy (10_Wiki/00_Raw/20_Skills/30_Projects/40_Log). It is wired into production: server_app.py:987 instantiates it, server_app.py:1543 mounts /garden routes (latticeai/api/garden.py), and latticeai/api/chat.py:368 injects gardener.get_relevant_context() into every chat turn alongside KG context. Tool registry still describes a 'local knowledge garden' (latticeai/core/tool_registry.py:212-214). This is an undisclosed knowledge silo contradicting the platform's one-sentence identity, and it isn't mentioned in FEATURE_STATUS.md at all.

problems.title: Identity is split: 'Digital Brain Platform' in marketing docs, 'AI workspace' everywhere that ships
problems.detail: Only README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md (rewritten in v3.6.0 commit fa89a84) say Digital Brain. The product constitution PROJECT_PRINCIPLES.md:3 still opens 'Lattice AI is a local-first AI workspace...' and never mentions a brain. pyproject.toml:8, package.json description, and vscode-extension/package.json all say 'local-first AI workspace platform'. docs/EDITION_STRATEGY.md:8 defines Community as an 'AI workspace platform'. The /app SPA's information architecture is infrastructure taxonomy, not a brain: nav groups are workspace/data/retrieval/compute/platform/system (static/v3/js/core/routes.js:13-19), and the Knowledge Graph — supposedly 'the primary surface' — is one item labeled 'Knowledge' inside the 'retrieval' group (routes.js:36), while Home remains the landing view ('Your local-first AI workspace at a glance', routes.js:28). Total grep across the repo: 'digital brain' appears in ~15 files, mostly changelogs; the durable identity artifacts contradict it.

problems.title: README overclaims agent/workflow capability that FEATURE_STATUS admits is deterministic theater
problems.detail: README.md:58-60 promises 'Automate with agents you can inspect — workflows leave behind plans, reviews, retries', README.md:75-76 'Create repeatable agent workflows for research, coding, analysis, and documentation', and README.md:111-116 shows an 'agent run with roles, logs, review, and retry'. FEATURE_STATUS.md:318-319 admits 'The default runner is deterministic and LLM-free by design... it does not call a model', and the prior internal audit (docs/V4_DIGITAL_BRAIN_RECOVERY.md §4.1) found the planner emits a canned 3-step plan, workflow tool nodes return {recorded:true} without executing, and fake plans/handoffs are persisted into the Knowledge Graph as provenance — directly undermining README.md:241 'Every node is explainable'. For a brand whose differentiator is honesty, the README marketing layer is the dishonest layer. Also flagged placeholder: hardcoded illustrative fusion-score meters in hybrid-search.js:183 (FEATURE_STATUS.md:267-269).

problems.title: Naming sprawl: at least nine identifiers for one product, two env prefixes, no brain anywhere in the install surface
problems.detail: Product 'Lattice AI'; pip+npm package 'ltcai'; CLI binaries both 'ltcai' AND 'LTCAI' (package.json bin maps both to bin/ltcai.js — an uppercase shell command is hostile and nonstandard, and README.md:159 teaches 'LTCAI' as the command); data dir '.ltcai'; gardener vault '.ltcai-brain'; GitHub repo 'LatticeAI'; Vercel project 'lattice-ai'; env vars split across LATTICEAI_* (~40 vars) and LATTICE_* (LATTICE_TZ, LATTICE_VERSION, LATTICE_EDITION, LATTICE_HOOK_CONTEXT/EVENT/ID/KIND). Internal concept names leak everywhere: 'Workspace OS', 'garden/gardener', 'P-Reinforce', 'My Computer', and 'Local Agent' — which FEATURE_STATUS.md:454-456 admits 'is honestly the on-device Lattice runtime — no separate desktop install', i.e. a misleading name kept for continuity. Nothing in the user-facing install path (pip install ltcai → LTCAI → /app) says 'brain'.

problems.title: Four overlapping 'where knowledge lives' concepts with no unifying brain model
problems.detail: (1) Knowledge Graph (SQLite, knowledge_graph.py) — 'your digital brain' per routes.js:36; (2) Memory — six tiers (workspace/project/agent/conversation/graph/vector) with its own 'brain' icon in nav (routes.js:37) and its own view; (3) the P-Reinforce garden vault (~/.ltcai-brain); (4) Workspace OS snapshots/durable context (workspace_os.json, with silent [-200:]/[-500:] truncation per docs/V4_DIGITAL_BRAIN_RECOVERY.md §4.2 — contradicting 'knowledge is durable'). A Digital Brain Platform needs one declared memory/knowledge model with the others defined as views or projections; today a user cannot answer 'where does my knowledge actually live and which one do I back up?' (KG portability exports only #1).

problems.title: Doc corpus is bilingual, version-stale, and self-contradictory
problems.detail: MODEL_POLICY.md:3 still says 'Lattice AI v2.2.0 uses a multimodal-first model policy' (current version 3.6.0) and mandates Korean-labeled disclosure fields (제작 국가/제작 회사/실행 방식/인터넷 사용 여부/모델명) which ARCHITECTURE.md:66-72 repeats verbatim in an otherwise-English doc. docs/kg-schema.md and docs/spec-vs-impl.md are entirely Korean and anchored to a 15MB PowerPoint (lattice_ai_full_spec.pptx) that is tracked in git. KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md is 38 lines and doesn't reflect the v3.6.0 schema, provenance, or portability it headlines. docs/ retains V2_ARCHITECTURE.md, V3_2_AUDIT.md, V3_FRONTEND.md, etc. with no archive separation. FEATURE_STATUS.md:172-173 itself flags 'several command/agent responses are Korean-only while the SPA is English (i18n inconsistency)'. docs/EDITION_STRATEGY.md still sells 'the full v2 platform' and 'Realtime Collaboration' as Community pillars.

problems.title: README presents a Vercel 'landing/demo surface' that is actually broken (HTTP 500 on every route)
problems.detail: README.md:40-42 says 'The Vercel site is a landing/download/demo surface only — never the runtime', implying a working surface. FEATURE_STATUS.md:500-507 records the only production deployment 'returns HTTP 500 on every route' with project.live=false. Either fix the landing deployment or remove the reference; pointing prospective users at a 500 contradicts the quality identity.

problems.title: Repo root undermines product credibility: ~30 release tarballs, logs, chat history, extracted package copy
problems.detail: The working tree root contains ltcai-0.2.2.tgz through ltcai-3.6.0.tgz (~30 tarballs), an extracted ltcai-0.3.1/ directory, server.log, ai_server.log, chat_history.json, telegram_chats.json, and both venv/ and a .venv. These are untracked (git ls-files confirms 0 tarballs tracked) but the 15MB lattice_ai_full_spec.pptx IS tracked. First impression of the 'durable, portable, user-owned knowledge' product is a cluttered junk drawer; also a privacy smell to keep chat_history.json beside the repo.

problems.title: Identity surface sprawl: Telegram/Discord/Codex bots and legacy static pages dilute the product story
problems.detail: Root carries telegram_bot.py, codex_telegram_bot.py, CLOUD_BOTS.md, LATTICEAI_DISCORD_* env hooks, plus nine legacy static HTML pages (static/chat.html, graph.html, admin.html, workspace.html, account.html, agents.html, activity.html, plugins.html, workflows.html) shipped in parallel with the /app SPA that FEATURE_STATUS.md:69-72 declares 'superseded and not the audited surface' yet still routes (GET /agents serves static/agents.html). For v4, each surface should either be a first-class brain client or be deleted; today they are unaudited side doors into the same data.

opportunities.title: Write the Digital Brain constitution and propagate it to every identity artifact
opportunities.detail: Rewrite PROJECT_PRINCIPLES.md as the Digital Brain Platform constitution (knowledge durable / models temporary / user sovereignty / no silos / no fake functionality), then update the one-line description in pyproject.toml, package.json, vscode-extension/package.json, docs/EDITION_STRATEGY.md, and the /app Home copy (routes.js:28) to match README/ARCHITECTURE. Add a GLOSSARY.md defining the canonical vocabulary: Brain = KG + memory + provenance; Workspace = a brain's container/scope; Capture/Explore/Recall/Act as user-facing verbs. This is mostly text, high leverage, and prevents every future doc from re-forking the identity.

opportunities.title: Absorb or delete the P-Reinforce garden — one brain, no silos
opportunities.detail: Route PReinforceGardener content through latticeai/services/ingestion.py so notes land in the Knowledge Graph with provenance (source_type=note), reimplement /garden/tree and gardener.get_relevant_context as KG queries (or markdown export views over the KG, preserving the Obsidian-compatibility value), and retire ~/.ltcai-brain as a write target (keep a one-time importer). Update tool_registry.py knowledge_* tool descriptions. Until done, FEATURE_STATUS.md must disclose the garden as a known silo — its absence from the honesty ledger is itself a defect.

opportunities.title: Honesty pass on README and run labeling: make marketing as honest as FEATURE_STATUS
opportunities.detail: Rewrite README's agent/workflow claims to match reality ('deterministic, replayable run scaffolding; LLM-backed execution is the v4 roadmap'), or gate the claims on the v4 real-runtime work. Persist mode:'simulation' on deterministic multi-agent/workflow runs and stop writing fabricated plans/handoffs into the KG as provenance (this is also queue item C1 in docs/V4_DIGITAL_BRAIN_RECOVERY.md). Label the hybrid-search explainer meters 'illustrative'. Fix or remove the broken Vercel landing reference. The brand promise 'every node is explainable' only survives if no subsystem writes fiction into the graph.

opportunities.title: Unify naming: one brand, one command, one env prefix, one data home
opportunities.detail: Decide the canonical triple — e.g. brand 'Lattice', CLI 'lattice' (keep 'ltcai' as deprecated alias; drop the uppercase 'LTCAI' bin), data home '~/.lattice/' containing brain.db, blobs, and config. Migrate LATTICE_* stragglers (LATTICE_TZ/VERSION/EDITION/HOOK_*) to a single LATTICEAI_ (or LATTICE_) prefix with deprecation shims. Rename user-facing leaks: 'Local Agent' → 'Local Runtime', 'My Computer' → 'This Device', kill 'P-Reinforce' and 'garden' from API paths and tool descriptions (keep route aliases for compatibility). Document the mapping in the v4 release notes.

opportunities.title: Re-architect /app IA around the brain, not around infrastructure
opportunities.detail: Make the Knowledge Graph (Brain) view the default landing surface (it already has Explore/Status/Sources/Capture/Backup tabs) and regroup nav by user intent: Capture (files, browser, notes), Explore (graph, search), Recall (memory, chat), Act (agents, workflows), System (models, settings, admin). Today's groups (workspace/data/retrieval/compute/platform/system in routes.js:13-19) describe the implementation, not the product; 'Knowledge' as a sub-item of 'retrieval' buries the headline asset. Rename the 'Memory' view's relationship to the graph explicitly (memory as a projection of the brain).

opportunities.title: Unify the four knowledge stores into one declared brain data model
opportunities.detail: Specify in an updated KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md (or new BRAIN_MODEL.md) that the KG SQLite store is the single durable substrate; define memory tiers, workspace snapshots/timeline, and any markdown vault as projections/views with explicit durability and backup semantics; remove the silent [-200:]/[-500:] truncation of memories/traces (it contradicts 'knowledge is durable'); and extend kg_portability so 'export my brain' provably captures everything a user would lose otherwise (including chat history and memories, which today live in chat_history.json and workspace_os.json outside the KG backup).

opportunities.title: Docs hygiene: one language policy, archive the past, kill the pptx anchor
opportunities.detail: Pick English as the canonical doc language with Korean as translated copies (or vice versa — but one rule); translate/replace docs/kg-schema.md and docs/spec-vs-impl.md; refresh MODEL_POLICY.md (stale 'v2.2.0') and KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md to v4 reality; move V2_*/V3_* docs and PLATFORM_COMPLETION_REPORT/VISUAL_REBUILD notes to docs/archive/; remove lattice_ai_full_spec.pptx from git (15MB tracked binary) and replace it with a markdown spec. Localize the model source-disclosure fields via i18n keys instead of hardcoded Korean labels in English architecture docs.

opportunities.title: Institutionalize FEATURE_STATUS as the product's public honesty contract
opportunities.detail: Promote the FEATURE_STATUS pattern into the v4 brand: keep the WORKING/PARTIAL/PLACEHOLDER/DISABLED legend, add a CI check that README feature claims link to a FEATURE_STATUS entry, add the missing entries (P-Reinforce garden, Telegram/Discord bots, legacy static pages, simulation-mode agents), and surface the ledger in-app (an 'About → What's real' panel reading a machine-readable status file). 'The honest local AI brain' is a defensible identity precisely because competitors can't easily copy it.
